title: Embedding the cell-window computation
statement: Let $Q,T$ be types with decidable equality, let $k\in\mathbb{N}$, and let $\iota$ embed the three tape indices into the $k$ tape indices. Let $ws$ be a Boolean word and $s\in\mathbb{N}$ such that its binary value is $s$. Suppose a three-tape configuration $a$ on input $x$ starts in the initial sweep phase; tape 0 stores $ws$ as a buffer on the interval from one cell left of its head through the cell indexed by $|ws|$, tape 2 is blank on that interval, tape 1 is blank from one cell left through the cell indexed by $2s+1$, and the output is empty. For any surrounding tapes, head positions, and output prefix used to embed the configuration into $k$ tapes, there is a time $t\le18(s+|ws|)+32$ such that the embedded machine has not reached its designated done state before $t$, every work-tape head stays within distance $2s+|ws|+3$ of its initial position through time $t$, and at time $t$ the designated state is reached and the output remains the prefix. The embedded configuration agrees with its initial version except on the interval of tape $\iota(1)$ from its head position through the next $2s+1$ cells, where the buffer now stores $s$ false cell symbols, then one true cell symbol, then $s$ false cell symbols.
hypotheses_covered: configuration $a$ starts in the specified initial sweep state
tape 0 agrees with the buffer for $ws$ on $-1\le p\le |ws|$ relative to its head
tape 2 is blank on $-1\le p\le |ws|$ relative to its head
tape 1 is blank on $-1\le p\le 2s+1$ relative to its head
arbitrary ambient tapes, head positions, and output prefix
